lines.text: Overclocking lasers. Remember, aiming is still your responsibility.
Maximum power to weapons. Accuracy not guaranteed, but it will look spectacular.
Rerouting power to shields. Please hold your breath to conserve auxiliary life support.
Shield reinforcement active. Cowardice setting: Optimized.
Thrusters boosted. Enjoy going faster toward the obstacles you were trying to avoid.
Maximum steering response. Try not to overcorrect us into a canyon wall.
Reactor balanced. Disappointing all subsystems equally.
Power distributed evenly. Perfect symmetry for average performance.
Shifting power grids. Warning: Cockpit cup holder heater now offline.
Diverting power. Do not touch any buttons that feel abnormally warm.
Power rerouted. The coffee machine has filed a formal complaint.
Shield power increased. A bold investment in not becoming debris.
Engines prioritized. I have reduced the turning circle, not the consequences.
Primary lockout active. I hope you practiced your evasive side-dash.
We are overheating. Releasing the primary trigger is free, you know.
Weapon systems thermal limit reached. Two seconds of meditative silence initiated.
Heat at one hundred percent. Cooling down. Please use this time to reflect on your trigger-happy life.
Weapons cooled. Try to fire in bursts, or don't. I enjoy the quiet time during lockouts.
Tachyon Beam Cannon online. Continuous beam, wider footprint, same terrible accuracy.
Quad Plasma Repeaters selected. Remember to lead your targets; they do not wish to be hit.
Baseline Twin Pulse selected. Reliable, precise, and completely free of upgrade fees.
Thermal lockout. Our lasers have requested a brief vacation.
Weapons cooled. Short bursts remain an available lifestyle choice.
Four plasma bolts per volley. Statistically, one should meet somebody.
Combat multiplier active! Try not to scratch the paint; it resets the bonus.
Hull damage detected. Streak broken. There goes my commission.
Ten-kill streak! Four-times credit multiplier! Please survive long enough to spend them.
Combat streak rising. Our financial department is starting to respect you.
Threat intercepted. My sensors are thoroughly unimpressed but functionally relieved.
Bonus multiplier increased. Apparently panic can be profitable.
Streak terminated. The accounting department would like a word.
Missile intercepted. That was almost an unscheduled interior renovation.
Shields depleted. Initiating prayer protocols.
Shields recharging. Please refrain from getting hit for the next few seconds.
Minor hull damage. This ship is leased, you know.
Hull integrity critical. I would advise checking the resale value of our ejector seat.
Structural compromise detected. That sounded expensive.
Shields exhausted. The hull has reluctantly accepted responsibility.
Hull integrity critical. Please stop negotiating with incoming fire.
Shield recovery underway. A short period without explosions would be appreciated.
Ignis Prime volcanic activity detected. Lava is hot. Just in case your eyes were offline.
High ambient thermal levels. Venting weapon heat is going to be a leisurely affair.
Extreme cold detected. Steering response reduced by thirty-five percent. Drifting is cool, but not into glaciers.
Frost impact! Hydraulics frozen. Turning speed restricted. Enjoy the scenic route.
City transit lanes ahead. Please do not attempt to park in the moving laser gates.
Laser gate sequence active. Reminding pilot: the center is safe, the edges are dissecting.
Stealth signature detected. Swarm rockets are currently experiencing an existential crisis.
Target cloaked. I suggest using an EMP Nova, or just firing blindly and hoping for a miracle.
Approaching Xylo-Mire. Corrosive geysers active. Do not roll down the cockpit windows.
Spore density rising. Radar visibility degraded. The green glow is normal. Mostly.
Acid spray detected. Our warranty specifically excludes being marinated.
Hive Mothers ahead. Please resist the urge to ring every doorbell.
Egg-shaped contacts detected. Scrambling them may attract the parents.
Swarm Rockets primed. Warning: Homing rockets still require you to face the target.
EMP Nova ready. Clearing local missile locks. Stunned systems will recover before your anxiety does.
Concussion missile loaded. Good for knocking sense into heavy gunships.
Flare deployed. Missile diverted. Go play with the bright light, little threat.
Countermeasures on cooldown. You have a few seconds to think about your life choices.
Secondary ammunition depleted. I can offer you some moral support, but it deals zero damage.
Swarm rockets away. Finally, a weapon willing to help with the aiming.
EMP discharged. Nearby electronics are reconsidering their career choices.
Ordnance bay empty. Harsh language remains unlimited.
Ejection sequence active! See you at Astra Market! Your upgrades will not be joining us.
Ejection successful. Pilot recovered. Upgrades vaporized. Wallet remains intact, thankfully.
Welcome to the Rescue Skiff. It has room for three ordnance units, weak plating, and smells like desperation.
Launching in the Rescue Skiff. This is what happens when you spend your last credit on cockpit decals.
New hardware installed. Let us see how quickly you can destroy this upgrade.
Autodocking complete. Welcome back to Astra Market. Repairs are free; counseling is extra.
Emergency extraction authorized. We are keeping the pilot and editing the ship out.
Upgrade installed. Your survival odds have improved on paper.
Docking complete. Complimentary repairs. Complimentary judgment.
Safe route selected. An inspiring victory for basic risk assessment.
Taking the easy route. I have informed the insurance company of this historic development.
Standard corridor confirmed. We can admire the explosions from a financially responsible distance.
Easy route locked. Apparently survival is part of the strategy today.
Avoiding the hazard trench. A rare example of learning without an explosion.
Safe route it is. The hull has sent a thank-you note.
Hazard route selected. I will start drafting the expense report.
Taking the narrow trench. More rewards, less room for your usual creative steering.
Hard route confirmed. The repair crew has canceled its lunch break.
Hazard corridor locked. Confidence detected. Supporting evidence remains inconclusive.
Extra defenses ahead. You really do consider warning signs a personal invitation.
Hard route selected. Please collect the supplies before becoming one.
